name: process_docx_tool
description: Inspect a Microsoft Word .docx document natively, validate native page output against the BADGERS content-tree schema, and create an adaptive page plan. It produces page images only for individual pages that need visual interpretation or Textract OCR; simple pages remain native DOCX output.

document_path.description: S3 URL (s3://bucket/key) or absolute local path to a .docx source document. Legacy .doc and macro-enabled documents are rejected.

session_id.description: Runtime session ID. A deterministic session-scoped artifact prefix is used when supplied.

max_image_size_mb.description: Maximum size in MiB for a rendered image selected for Vision AI or Textract OCR. Default: 4.0.

job_id.description: Identifier of the active analysis run.

result.description: JSON object containing page_plan_uri, rendered_pdf_uri, page_count, and one entry per page with route (native_docx, textract_ocr, hybrid, vision_ai), score, reasons, schema validation status, native output URI, and optional image URI.

success.description: Whether DOCX inspection, rendering, and page-plan generation succeeded.
